تعارضت (form VI)
# تَعَارَضْتُ (taʕāraḍtu) /ta.ʕaː.radˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
# تَعَارَضْتَ (taʕāraḍta) /ta.ʕaː.radˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
# تَعَارَضْتِ (taʕāraḍti) /ta.ʕaː.radˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَارَضَ (taʕāraḍa)
# تَعَارَضَتْ (taʕāraḍat) /ta.ʕaː.ra.dˤat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
